summary: Frontend regression testing of iteration-2 changes for Yayasan Raudhatul Jannah admin. Verified: (1) Public navbar dual logos + two-line brand + 'Profil Majelis' renamed link → PASS. (2) Data Jamaah expanded table columns (NIK, Tempat Lahir, Tanggal Lahir, Nama Orang Tua, Alamat) → PASS. (3) Modal renders id_jamaah as disabled+readonly auto_id field, ijazah_nama_dalam as dynamic_list with + add button → PASS. (4) CRITICAL FAIL: auto_id compute function is NEVER invoked in CrudPage.js. Selecting Cabang + Gender does not populate id_jamaah — field stays empty and Save fails with 'ID Jamaah wajib diisi'. Cannot create a jamaah record via the UI. (5) Regression on Cabang/Guru/Pengurus CRUD → PASS (list loads, modal opens).

ui_bugs.issue: The `compute` prop on auto_id fields (used by DataJamaah for id_jamaah) is defined in field config but never invoked anywhere in /app/frontend/src/components/admin/CrudPage.js. There is no useEffect watching form.cabang_id / form.gender that calls f.compute(form, rows, rawOptions) to update form[f.key]. Also `rawOptions` state is declared (line 32) but `setRawOptions` is never called — so even if compute were wired, it would receive an empty raw.cabang_id array. Result: after selecting Cabang + Gender in the Tambah Data Jamaah modal, the 'ID Jamaah' input stays empty, and Save throws 'ID Jamaah wajib diisi'. Blocks the entire create-jamaah flow.

integration_issues.flow: Create Jamaah (Data Jamaah > Tambah Data > Simpan)
integration_issues.issue: Save always fails because id_jamaah cannot be filled (auto_id not computed). User has no way to complete the create flow. Existing seed rows use legacy JAM-#### IDs, not the new BR{cabang}-{L/P}-#### format — new format is unverifiable end-to-end until the compute wiring is fixed.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description — console warning (accessibility).

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/components/admin/CrudPage.js: (a) populate rawOptions when loading optionsFrom data — e.g. setRawOptions((o) => ({ ...o, [f.key]: data })); (b) add a useEffect that, whenever `form` or `rows` change, iterates fields.filter(f => f.type === 'auto_id' && f.compute) and calls setForm to set form[f.key] = f.compute(form, rows, rawOptions) — only when it differs, to avoid loops; (c) ensure the auto_id useEffect is scoped to when creating (not editing), or re-computes only if form[f.key] is empty, so editing existing rows keeps their persisted id.
Verify new ID format BR{cabang}-{L/P}-#### matches backend expectations (backend may still validate JAM-#### pattern — needs backend regex check).
Add aria-describedby / DialogDescription to CrudPage Dialog to remove Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: CrudPage.js line 32: `rawOptions` state defined but setter never called — dead state.
CrudPage.js: no handler wires the `f.compute` callback of auto_id fields — the feature is inert.
DataJamaah.js computeJamaahId uses `rows.filter(...).length + 1` — race prone: if two admins add simultaneously, both get the same seq. Consider computing on the backend or at save time only.
computeJamaahId derives cabang code from `cabang.id_cabang` (backend field) via digit-strip; if id_cabang naming changes this silently returns '00'. Should validate.
Existing seed jamaah still use JAM-#### IDs; migration/reformat plan needed if new BR format is authoritative.

Clean up any TEST_ rows via delete button. Route is /admin/jamaah (NOT /admin/data-jamaah).
rca of the issue: Root cause: In /app/frontend/src/components/admin/CrudPage.js, the `auto_id` field type was added to render a disabled input, but the reactive logic to compute its value from other form fields is missing. The `compute` function attached to the field config (DataJamaah.js line 64) is never called anywhere. Additionally, `rawOptions` (which the compute function needs to look up cabang data by id) is declared as state but never populated by the optionsFrom loader (line 55-66 only sets `options` with mapped {value,label} pairs, discarding the raw cabang objects). Reproduction: login as admin → /admin/jamaah → Tambah Data → select any Cabang → select Gender → observe id_jamaah remains empty → click Simpan → toast 'ID Jamaah wajib diisi'. Mitigation: (1) in the optionsFrom useEffect, also call setRawOptions((o) => ({...o, [f.key]: data})) alongside setOptions; (2) add a useEffect with deps [form, rows, rawOptions] that iterates auto_id fields and setForm to include computed value when it changes.
